title: Retention Concessions on Noticed Rent Increases, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Desk guidance — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.** A tenant who calls about a noticed rent increase that is not yet in effect may be given one retention concession that lowers the increased rent, recorded with the same effective date as the increase and pointing at it.

A retention concession is recorded only after the agreement's balance due stands at zero or below.

Put the other way round: while the agreement's balance due stands above zero, no retention concession is recorded on it; once the balance due stands at zero or below, the concession may be recorded.

Increase notices go only to agreements in active status; that standing requirement governs the sending of an increase notice and not the recording of a retention concession on an increase already noticed.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Subject | A noticed rent increase not yet in effect |
| Number | One retention concession, lowering the increased rent |
| Effective date | The same as the increase's |
| Link | The concession points at the increase it lowers |
| Balance due | At zero or below when the concession is recorded |
| Standing of the agreement | The active-status requirement for increase notices bears on sending a notice, not on recording a concession on an increase already noticed |

### Recording the concession: `grant_parking_retention_concession_aac1dee9`

**Capability.** Records a retention concession that lowers a noticed parking rent increase: a rent change notice of the kind "retention concession", dated today, is added to the agreement's rent change history with the concession rent given, linked to the increase it modifies and carrying that increase's effective date, pre-increase rent, street rate and tenure at notice. The tenant sees the concession rent as the rent that will apply from the increase's effective date.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `grant_parking_retention_concession_aac1dee9` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `parking_rental_id` | The parking agreement number of the agreement whose increase is lowered, as returned by the parking agreement lookup for this tenant (identifier). |
| `source_rate_change_id` | The rent change number of the noticed increase the concession modifies, as returned by the parking rent change lookup for the agreement (identifier). |
| `new_rent` | The monthly rent in USD that applies under the concession, with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as given. |

**Return.** The call is complete when the receipt comes back with `rate_change_id` (the concession's rent change number), `parking_rental_id`, `source_rate_change_id` (the increase modified), `change_reason` (always `retention_concession`), `previous_rent` (USD, the pre-increase rent of the increase), `new_rent` (USD, the concession rent), `notice_date` (YYYY-MM-DD date granted) and `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD rent due date from which the concession rent applies).
